workflow.shipped.merge-after-accept.name: Merge workflow
workflow.shipped.merge-after-accept.for: For a repository whose work you accept: once the work's requests are answered you review it, and it merges into the line.
workflow.shipped.merge-automatic.name: Automatic merge workflow
workflow.shipped.merge-automatic.for: For a development repository whose main branch is its line: the work merges into the line once its requests are answered, with no review.
workflow.shipped.documents.name: Documents workflow
workflow.shipped.documents.for: For a kind of task whose paths are documents: the work merges into the line once it is done, with no review.
workflow.shipped.branch-to-push.name: Branch workflow
workflow.shipped.branch-to-push.for: For a repository you push yourself: you review the work, and it lands on a branch of its own for you to push.
workflow.shipped.pull-request.name: Hosted merge workflow
workflow.shipped.pull-request.for: For a repository on a code host: you review the work, and a plugin pushes its branch and opens a pull request for you to merge.
workflow.shipped.integrated.name: Integration workflow
workflow.shipped.integrated.for: For a line that integrates its work: you review the work onto a branch, and you ask for it to be integrated into the line.
workflow.shipped.integrated-no-press.for: For a line whose gates the repository declares and accepted: each piece of work is integrated into the line once its agent is done.
workflow.shipped.release.name: Release workflow
workflow.shipped.release.for: For a repository that releases: the work is checked, you review it, it merges into the line, and the Local release plugin finds a pending release, records it and copies the built package into its own registry folder; with none pending the run ends at the line.
workflow.shipped.in-place.name: In-place workflow
workflow.shipped.in-place.for: For any department, a folder or a system included: one session at a time works in its own place, and once the work's requests are answered you review it there; nothing lands.
workflow.shipped.plan-review-apply.name: Plan, review and apply workflow
workflow.shipped.plan-review-apply.for: For a system: one session at a time plans its change, you review the plan, and the plan you accepted is applied; a plan gone stale goes back to the work, which plans again from what the system holds.
workflow.shipped.in-copy.name: In-copy workflow
workflow.shipped.in-copy.for: For a folder: each session works in a copy of it, you review what the copy changed, and what you accepted is brought back; a file changed in both the folder and the copy waits for your choice.
